title: NIST WebBook: Argon is Ar, molecular weight 39.948 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Argon as Ar, molecular weight 39.948 amu, CAS 7440-37-1.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Argon, CAS Registry Number 7440-37-1, lists molecular formula Ar and molecular weight 39.948 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 39.9623831225 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/Ar. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
